prose: Launch HN for Rivet (YC W23), an Apache 2.0 orchestrator for agent workloads built on the actor model and S3. Each actor is a long-lived process with in-memory state, a SQLite database, WebSockets and scheduling, run on plain Node.js, Bun or Rust. Claims: 4.99 ms p99 cold starts, 72 KB RAM per actor, scaling to billions. It offers durable scheduling, Vitest support and upgrade control, and positions itself against Cloudflare Durable Objects and Orleans-style virtual actors.
highlights: Actors with in-memory state and per-actor SQLite
Claims 4.99 ms p99 cold start and 72 KB per actor (self-reported)
Runs on Node.js, Bun or Rust; Apache 2.0
Compared to Durable Objects and Orleans
